comparisons.peer_summary: The company operates through four business segments: Consumer Banking, Global Wealth & Investment Management (GWIM), Global Banking, and Global Markets, with remaining operations recorded in All Other.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citigroup and Bank of America disclose their organizational structure through specific operating segments. Citigroup is managed via five operating segments (Services, Markets, Banking, Wealth, and U.S. Personal Banking) with unassigned activities in All Other. Similarly, Bank of America operates through four business segments (Consumer Banking, GWIM, Global Banking, and Global Markets) with remaining operations in All Other. Both firms utilize an 'All Other' bucket for unassigned or residual operations to reconcile segment results to consolidated totals.

sentences.text: Citigroup is managed pursuant to five operating segments: Services, Markets, Banking, Wealth and U.S. Personal Banking.
Activities not assigned to the operating segments are included in All Other.

Through our various bank and nonbank subsidiaries throughout the U.S. and in international markets, we provide a diversified range of banking and nonbank financial services and products through four business segments: Consumer Banking, Global Wealth & Investment Management (GWIM), Global Banking and Global Markets, with the remaining operations recorded in All Other.

comparisons.peer_summary: Effective in Q2 2024, JPMorganChase combined its former Corporate & Investment Bank and Commercial Banking segments to form the Commercial & Investment Bank (CIB), resulting in three reportable segments: Consumer & Community Banking (CCB), CIB, and Asset & Wealth Management (AWM), with remaining activities in Corporate.
comparisons.comparison: Both Citigroup and JPMorgan Chase define their reportable business segments for management purposes. Citigroup is managed pursuant to five operating segments (Services, Markets, Banking, Wealth, and U.S. Personal Banking). JPMorganChase, following a reorganization in Q2 2024, reports through three reportable segments (Consumer & Community Banking, Commercial & Investment Bank, and Asset & Wealth Management). Both disclosures identify the specific segments used for internal management and external reporting, noting that remaining activities fall into a separate 'Corporate' or 'All Other' category.
